applicable_subject: 外国航空公司、往返贝宁的定期国际航线
english_analytical_paraphrase: Prior authorization for scheduled international services, subject to international agreements in force.
comparative_finding: 共同许可机制；贝宁文字明确限定定期航线
interpretation_boundary: 不能推断非定期免许可；不能把许可要求本身视为违反SAATM

comparative_finding: 准入附持续监管；转引链须展开
interpretation_boundary: 非第五航权个案授权；不把未转引的条文认定绝不适用

applicable_subject: 往返贝宁的外国航空运输企业
english_analytical_paraphrase: Operational information is submitted under applicable regulations.
comparative_finding: 贝宁用现行法规，塞内加尔明确要求由decree规定条件
interpretation_boundary: 提交不等于票价核准；审批期限与费用仍未知

applicable_subject: 外国有偿定期/非定期国际服务；另含国内运输
decision_authority: 条文不另列逐案发证者
english_analytical_paraphrase: International commercial carriage is linked to ASAs; domestic carriage reserves include other Union carriers.
comparative_finding: 该条把国际商业上下客货与国内运输分开；Union承运人显式纳入国内保留条款
interpretation_boundary: cabotage不同于第五航权；不因条文存在即确认某航司获权

english_analytical_paraphrase: Foreign-carrier provisions apply without prejudice to UEMOA rules.
comparative_finding: 区域法保留是理解第234条的前提
interpretation_boundary: 不能孤立234条断言排斥其他UEMOA承运人

applicable_subject: 外国公司设立/经营往返塞内加尔国际航线
english_analytical_paraphrase: Prior authorization is required for creation and operation of international routes.
comparative_finding: 同样设置行政许可；本条未出现régulières限定词
interpretation_boundary: 文义差异不直接证明实际许可范围或开放程度不同

english_analytical_paraphrase: Extends tariff, technical-control and regional regulatory obligations to foreign carriers.
comparative_finding: 比单读231更完整：转引涉及UEMOA票价/许可证规则
interpretation_boundary: 不能把法条交叉引用数量当监管强度指数

applicable_subject: 往返塞内加尔的外国运输企业
english_analytical_paraphrase: Submission conditions are to be specified by decree.
comparative_finding: 需寻找具体配套decree，不能用飞越表单代替
interpretation_boundary: 未找到≠未制定；不能推断任何现行收费或处理天数

applicable_subject: 塞内加尔境内两点间有偿运输
decision_authority: 特殊临时例外机关未在本条列明
english_analytical_paraphrase: Domestic carriage is reserved subject to special temporary derogations and the chapter’s regional-law safeguard.
comparative_finding: 国家保留表述较窄，但须与230及UEMOA同读
interpretation_boundary: 不构成两国第五航权自由化排名证据
